sentences.en: The Georgia Guidestones were a granite monument in Elbert County, Georgia, United States, and first erected in 1980.
The monument was 19 feet 3 inches (5.87 m) tall, made from six granite slabs weighing 237,746 pounds (107,840 kg) in all.
The structure was sometimes known as an "American Stonehenge" or "Georgia's Stonehenge".
